scene.camera_angle: wide-angle, low-angle perspective from a slightly elevated vantage point
scene.mood: serene, majestic, peaceful, and slightly nostalgic
scene.color_palette: deep blues, soft purples, fiery oranges, and vivid reds

attributes.description: towering, jagged peak with dark, craggy rock face partially covered in snow, catching the last rays of the setting sun
traditional Norwegian fishing cabins painted in vibrant red and white, small, wooden, with steep, snow-laden roofs, some with visible chimneys and windows glowing faintly with warm interior light
rocky, snow-dusted shoreline with clusters of traditional Norwegian fishing cabins
calm, mirror-like fjord water reflecting the sky and the village with soft, silky motion blur suggesting a long exposure technique

breathtaking gradient of colors: deep purples and blues blend into soft pinks, oranges, and pale golds near the horizon, with wispy, streaked clouds suggesting motion and the transition from day to night
